claims.value: Dayhoff is a protein language model using a hybrid state-space Mamba and Transformer architecture with Mixture-of-Experts. It is trained on 3.34 billion protein sequences and supports unconditional design, zero-shot mutation effect prediction, and scaffold design.
claims.evidence: Dayhoff is an Atlas of both protein sequence data and generative language models... Dayhoff architecture is a hybrid of state-space Mamba layers and Transformer self-attention
tags: protein-generation... This model should not be used to generate anything that is not a protein sequence
Trained with an autoregressive objective in both N→C and C→N directions, Dayhoff supports order-agnostic infilling
